title: 第9章 希望在前方第10章 勇敢的面对
content_zh:
第九章 希望在前方
杜之德挣扎着从地上爬起身，肚子上传来的剧痛让他丧失了理性，在所有的下属面前被傻子少爷殴打，这样的耻辱几乎是让他颜面无存，怒火直接烧红了眼睛，忘记了尊卑，他站起身一声大吼，“荣德，给我操家伙，老子今天非拆了这个小废物的骨头出来熬汤喝。”
“……老大！”荣德本来打算是动手，不过，这个时候徐荣跟着走进了厨房，他的眼神扫过来的时候，荣德就呆住了，一动也不敢再动。
“荣德！！家伙给我！！”杜之德又吼了一声。
“你们今天谁敢动，别怪我无情，全部打断双腿丢出府去。”秦岚冷哼一声，“还真反了天了，你们这群垃圾，对着主子就是这种态度。还有杜之德，你很好，从现在开始你被除名了，你最好赶紧去收拾东西滚蛋，否则，我丢你出去的时候，恐怕让你更丢脸。”
“啊呀，我打死你个小混蛋。”杜之德那里听的进去，他也没有想为什么一直懦弱的傻子少爷怎么突然强势了起来，顺手抓住旁边的铁锅，就往秦岚身上砸来。
有徐荣在，秦岚自然无需动手，黑色的铁锅被徐荣的拳头给砸了回去，一下子罩在了杜之德的头上，然后，徐荣朝他的膝盖就是一脚，令人牙酸的骨裂声响起，杜之德惨嚎一声，顿时扑倒在地上，抱着腿疯狂的翻滚起来。这一下，厨房没有人再敢乱动，所有人的心里都只有一个想法……
这个傻子少爷，今天好像是真的不一样了。
“恩恩，到底有没有吃的？”秦岚也不再管地上的那位，找了个位置坐下来，“给我弄点过来。”
“有……有！！”终于有人有反应了，这样下去不是办法啊，还是先把这位爷侍候好吧，不然他再翻脸打人，今天府中的所有人都不用指望吃晚饭了。
厨房里吃的东西多，水果蔬菜什么的很容易，洗洗切好就能端上来，秦岚随意吃了一些，然后也让徐荣也吃了一点，这才站起身拍了拍屁股，“晚上送我院子的饭菜，送三人份的，恩，分量多点，要是让我知道你们有人暗中动手脚，吐口水放垃圾什么的我直接拔了他的舌头，剁了手给丢出府去。”
“是！是！！”顿时一片附和声。
走回自己的院子，秦岚的母亲已经回来了，她的脸上还有几道深深的手指印，看到儿子进来，查红莹连忙捂住了脸。“岚儿，你回来了，你去那里了？今天有没有乖乖？”
“……”秦岚在她对面坐下。虽然秦岚是穿越过来的，但是她毕竟是自己这个身躯的母亲。“我看看你的脸。”
“岚儿，没什么好看的，娘是不小心撞到的。”查红莹连忙伸手阻拦儿子。“咦？岚儿，你今天怎么了？？你的手上，这是怎么回事？？”
秦岚手上那长长的鞭痕虽然已经不是很痛了，但是红红的样子依然很醒目，甚至有一些吓人。
“岚儿！！我可怜的岚儿，今天是谁又欺负你了？？”查红莹放声大哭起来，她自己被人欺负不要紧，可是儿子竟然被人打成这样，她顿时心痛的无法言表，小心的顺着鞭痕一点点的抚摸过去。
呃……秦岚本来想抽回手，不过，看到查红莹悲切的模样，他的心也软了，这是一个怎样深情的母亲啊！！
“滴~”熟悉的声音突然在耳边响起，秦岚顿时吓了一跳，原来，查红莹已经摸到了秦岚的手腕，并且摸到了那个开机钮！！
“系统检测中，请稍等……”

“……”秦岚实在无语，这也太容易开机了吧，看来要弄个东西保护住它才行。
“滴！欢迎回来，秦岚。”
“系统已经正式开启，但是请注意，因为不可知的异变，三国游戏自动开启。”
熟悉的生硬女声，重复着之前说过的话语，随着面前电脑光幕的展开，秦岚不置可否，他现在已经确定，除了他，别人根本看不到电脑的光幕，也听不到电脑的声音。
等等……等等，三国游戏自动开启，我岂不是要进入游戏了？？？
赶紧抬起手，秦岚点在了眼前光幕左上角的三国游戏图标上，试图关闭它，不过，没有什么效果，反而提示声再次响起。
“游戏已经正式启动运行，您是否要进入？”
“！！！！”原来，自己是想进就进，不想进就可以不进！！这一刻，秦岚几乎惊喜的跳起来，但是抬起眼却正好看到面前，查红莹正呆呆的看着他做一些莫名其妙的动作，已经伤心的落下泪来。
查红莹，等级3，统率1，体力46，精力21，内政44，勇武7，智谋11，魅力12，运气3，忠诚100，职位无，官职无，爵位无，技能无。（秦岚之母，没有什么特殊能力。）
“……”秦岚伸出手，把母亲抱入怀中，想给她安慰。不过他此刻的心情却是开心的想出去扮飞机飞一圈。原来，只要他有体力，游戏就可以保持一直启动状态，岂不是说，只要他安排好了城池，那边就可以自行发展？而只要能随时进入游戏，他就可以不停的发展壮大自己，现在只能招卡片的徐荣，但是未来不远他就一定可以招真的徐荣……呸，徐荣算什么，要招的是，关羽，张飞，赵云，吕布，夏侯惇，孙策……哇，似乎看到无数的三国名将在对自己招手，秦岚这一刻觉得自己不明确的未来突然清晰明了起来。
毫无疑问，秦岚有了这样一个金手指在手，坐拥无数名将良才，现在又来到了战乱的异世界，能走的似乎只有一条路……游戏中秦岚做了无数次的事情，争霸天下。
“母亲，请你不要再伤悲，你的儿子从今天开始，已经觉醒了，不会再是之前浑浑噩噩……他会给你一个想象不到的未来，请相信我。”秦岚轻轻的捧起母亲查红莹的脸，抚摸着那五道深深的痕迹。“您现在要做的，是好好的休息，什么都不要想，什么都不要问。”
“啊……”查红莹呆滞了，眼前这个眼神清明，说话条理清晰的大男孩，真的是自己的儿子吗？？天啊，老天终于开眼了，让儿子醒过来了！！！查红莹再也控制不住自己，抱紧了儿子，放声大哭起来。
content_en:
Chapter 9 Hope is ahead
Du Zhide struggled to get up from the ground. The severe pain in his stomach made him lose his rationality. He was beaten by the idiot young master in front of all his subordinates. Such humiliation almost made him lose face. His eyes were red with anger. Forgetting his dignity, he stood up and shouted, "Rong De, fuck me, I have to tear this little loser's bones out to make soup today."
"...Boss!" Rong De originally planned to take action, but at this time, Xu Rong followed him into the kitchen. When his eyes glanced over, Rong De was stunned and did not dare to move.
"Rong De!! Give me this guy!!" Du Zhide roared again.
"Whoever dares to move today, don't blame me for being ruthless. I broke all my legs and threw them out of the house." Qin Lan snorted coldly, "You are really rebelling. You bunch of trash have this attitude towards the master. And Du Zhide, you are very good. From now on, you are removed from the list. You'd better pack your things and get out. Otherwise, when I throw you out, I'm afraid it will make you even more embarrassed."
"Ah, I'll beat you to death, you little bastard." Du Zhide heard it, and he didn't think about why the cowardly and stupid young master suddenly became strong. He grabbed the iron pot next to him and threw it at Qin Lan.
With Xu Rong around, Qin Lan naturally didn't need to do anything. The black iron pot was smashed back by Xu Rong's fist, and it suddenly covered Du Zhide's head. Then, Xu Rong kicked him on the knee, causing a heart-breaking bone cracking sound. Du Zhide howled miserably, and immediately fell to the ground, holding his legs and rolling crazily. At this moment, no one in the kitchen dared to move anymore, everyone had only one thought in their minds...
This stupid young master seems to be really different today.
"Well, is there anything to eat?" Qin Lan no longer cared about the man on the ground and found a seat to sit down, "Bring me some."
"Yes... yes!!" Someone finally reacted. This was not the way to go. It was better to serve this man first. Otherwise, if he turned against others and hit others, no one in the house would have any hope of having dinner today.
There was a lot of food in the kitchen. Fruits and vegetables were easy to wash and cut before being served. Qin Lan ate some at will, and then let Xu Rong eat some too. Then he stood up and patted his butt, "The food in my yard tonight is for three people. Well, it's a bigger portion. If I know that one of you is secretly doing something, spitting and putting garbage in it, I will pull out his tongue, chop his hands and throw them out of the house."
"Yes! Yes!!" There was a sudden chorus of agreement.
Walking back to her yard, Qin Lan's mother had come back. There were still several deep finger prints on her face. When she saw her son coming in, Zha Hongying quickly covered her face. "Lan'er, you're back. Where have you been? Have you been good today?"
"..." Qin Lan sat down opposite her. Although Qin Lan traveled through time, she is still the mother of her own body. "Let me see your face."
"Lan'er, there's nothing good to see. Mom accidentally bumped into her." Zha Hongying quickly reached out to stop her son. "Eh? Lan'er, what happened to you today?? What's going on with your hands??"
Although the long whip marks on Qin Lan's hands are no longer very painful, the red appearance is still very eye-catching and even a little scary.
"Lan'er!! My poor Lan'er, who bullied you again today??" Zha Hongying burst into tears. It didn't matter that she was bullied, but her son was beaten like this. She felt heartbroken beyond words, and carefully stroked along the whip marks bit by bit.
Uh... Qin Lan originally wanted to withdraw his hand, but when he saw Cha Hongying's sad look, his heart softened. What an affectionate mother she is! !
"Beep~" A familiar voice suddenly sounded in her ears, and Qin Lan was startled. It turned out that Cha HongyingHe had already touched Qin Lan's wrist and touched the power button! !
"The system is checking, please wait..."
"..." Qin Lan was really speechless. It was too easy to turn on the phone. It seemed that he needed to get something to protect it.
"Dip! Welcome back, Qin Lan."
"The system has been officially started, but please note that due to unknown changes, the Three Kingdoms game will automatically start."
The familiar stiff female voice repeated what she had said before. As the computer light screen unfolded in front of her, Qin Lan was noncommittal. He was now certain that except for him, no one else could see the computer light screen or hear the computer's sound.
Wait... wait, the Three Kingdoms game automatically starts, am I going to enter the game? ? ?
Quickly raising her hand, Qin Lan clicked on the Three Kingdoms game icon in the upper left corner of the light screen in front of her, trying to close it. However, it had no effect, and the prompt sounded again.
"The game has been officially launched. Do you want to enter?"
"!!!" It turns out that I can go in if I want to, and if I don't want to, I don't have to! ! At this moment, Qin Lan almost jumped up in surprise, but when she raised her eyes, she saw Cha Hongying in front of her, staring blankly at him doing some inexplicable actions, and she was already crying sadly.
Cha Hongying, level 3, command 1, physical strength 46, energy 21, internal affairs 44, bravery 7, resourcefulness 11, charm 12, luck 3, loyalty 100, no position, no official position, no title, no skills. (Qin Lan’s mother has no special abilities.)
"..." Qin Lan stretched out her hand and took her mother into her arms, wanting to comfort her. But he was in a happy mood at the moment and wanted to go out and fly around pretending to be a plane. It turns out that as long as he has physical strength, the game can remain activated. Doesn't it mean that as long as he arranges the city, it can develop on its own? As long as he can enter the game at any time, he can continue to develop and strengthen himself. Now he can only recruit the card Xu Rong, but in the near future he will definitely be able to recruit the real Xu Rong... Bah, Xu Rong is nothing. The ones he wants to recruit are Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Lu Bu, Xiahou Dun, Sun Ce... Wow, it seems that countless famous generals from the Three Kingdoms are waving to him. Qin Lan feels that his unclear future suddenly becomes clear at this moment.
There is no doubt that Qin Lan has such a golden finger in his hand and has countless famous generals and talents. Now he has come to a war-torn world. There seems to be only one way to go... Qin Lan has done countless things in the game and strives for world domination.
"Mother, please don't be sad anymore. Your son has awakened from today on. He will no longer be confused as before... He will give you an unimaginable future. Please believe me." Qin Lan gently held up her mother Cha Hongying's face and stroked the five deep marks. "What you have to do now is to have a good rest, don't think about anything, don't ask anything."
"Ah..." Zha Hongying was stunned. Is this big boy with clear eyes and clear words in front of her really her son? ? Oh my god, God finally opened his eyes and let his son wake up! ! ! Zha Hongying couldn't control herself anymore, hugged her son tightly and cried loudly.
